This directory contains unmodified contract sources from Asuswrt-Merlin
3004.388.13, commit d1a59dcffbe0402c7ac8ac3090cb7c928510fbcd.
The original copyright and GNU GPL version 2 or later headers are retained.
Exact source URLs and SHA256 digests are recorded in sources.json and
uu_sources.json. COPYING-GPL-2.0.txt provides the license text.

The P7 candidate inherits the complete ordinary RT-AX86U upstream image,
including its OpenSSL 3.5 libraries, compatibility shims and native modules.
Corresponding upstream source: https://github.com/RMerl/asuswrt-merlin.ng/tree/d1a59dcffbe0402c7ac8ac3090cb7c928510fbcd
The upstream image/ZIP hashes and download URL are pinned separately in
build/merlin38813_sources.json. The software-center and Fancyss augmentation
retains the notices and source origins recorded by the P6 donor manifests.
The local source archive excludes firmware images, toolchains, credentials,
user configuration and actual router data.
